Sumant Sinha, Founder, Chairman & CEO of ReNew - one of the people who actually built India's renewable energy industry from nothing.
He explains:
• Why electricity is only 20 percent of total world energy and why closing that gap changes every geopolitical equation
• How China quietly captured the entire clean-tech supply chain over 25 years while the West was distracted
• Why America's AI power crisis is fundamentally a grid problem, and why India does not have that same constraint
• How to invest in renewable energy India for beginners
